description: Explain the 3-day release-age gate in PRs after applying package-specific policies
prBodyNotes: {{#unless isVulnerabilityAlert}}**Release-age gate:** `{{depName}}` requires **3 days** since release (not PR creation). See `renovate/stability-days` for the current status.{{/unless}}

{{#unless isVulnerabilityAlert}}If `renovate/stability-days` is pending, the release-age requirement is unmet or a required release timestamp is unavailable. Renovate rechecks on its scheduled runs; automerge also requires passing checks and an enabled automerge policy. The rebase/retry checkbox is optional and is not an approval request.{{/unless}}
